svg.aria-label: Chat Export for WhatsApp: white speech bubble with a download arrow on a green tile
svg.desc: Vector source for icons/icon16.png, icon32.png, icon48.png and icon128.png. Rounded green tile (#25D366 to #00A884 diagonal gradient) with a white speech bubble and a download arrow. The extension's icon generator draws the same design programmatically; at 16 px and 32 px it uses a slightly larger bubble and a thicker arrow so the shape still reads after downsampling.
